rollback_evidence: 1.0.12 ios port maintenance (IOS-M023): 'power inline auto [max N]', 'power inline never' or 'power inline static [max N]' on one PoE-capable Ethernet port, under the same revert timer, readback and undo as the other IOS port tables (the undo writes the earlier 'power inline' line, or 'power inline auto' when there was none). Command syntax, defaults (auto, 30000 mW) and the layout of show power inline INTERFACE (columns Interface Admin Oper Power Device Class Max; Admin auto, off or static) come from the Cisco Catalyst 9300 command reference and the Catalyst 9200 PoE troubleshooting guide (fixtures/ios_ios_port_maintenance/PROVENANCE.md). NOT measured on PoE hardware: the lab IOSvL2 and IOL-L2 nodes have no 'power inline' command (the configuration mode answers '% Unrecognized command', show power inline is refused), which Admin turns into poe_not_capable before any write. The check account reads show power inline INTERFACE (Admin column, operational command); the whole line, also the max value, is verified in the running configuration by the write account. Which Catalyst the person uses must be confirmed on that switch.
